sourceAvailability.actualWallpaper: The green/orange abstract design is visible in Apple’s dated September 26, 2023 Newsroom desktop image. The article exposes press-image JPG/ZIP downloads, not a standalone original wallpaper HEIC or SVG.
sourceAvailability.standaloneAppleWallpaper: No standalone Apple-hosted freely redistributable abstract Sonoma wallpaper file was established from the consulted Apple sources. This is a bounded research finding, not a claim that no such file exists.
sourceAvailability.icons: Apple’s version-selected Sonoma 14 guide supplies individual icon PNG URLs and a Launchpad screenshot. Those URLs are reference evidence only, not packaged or fetched at runtime.
sourceAvailability.redistribution: Public download availability is not permission to relicense or redistribute. The Sonoma SLA sections 1A, 1C, 2J and 4B do not establish an independent asset redistribution grant.
sourceAvailability.decision: Package original manually authored vector reconstructions, not downloaded or cropped Apple imagery.

sources.evidence: Sonoma released on September 26, 2023; desktop and Dock imagery; separate aerial screen saver feature.
Blue-violet upper-right, orange/coral flowing middle, forest green backdrop, bright green nested foreground ridges; light translucent Dock and app identities.
Corroborating early Sonoma desktop art; preview evidence is secondary to release-date image.
Launchpad screenshot and multicolor-grid Launchpad icon, rounded app icons.
sources.uncertainty: Version-selected page has no explicit original publication date. It is macOS 14 evidence, not proof every supplied icon pixel exactly matches 14.0 on release day.

wallpaper.creation: Manually authored Bézier hill shapes and gradients; no traced paths, embedded raster bytes, extracted system assets or screenshot crops.
wallpaper.fidelity: Evidence-based color and silhouette reconstruction, not pixel-identical original Apple wallpaper.
limitations: No aerial video, dynamic time-of-day HEIC layers, device bezel, widgets, Dock, menus or application screenshot content.
Exact hill geometry, gradient samples, crop and color-management are approximate.
